answer: Each answer's semantic entropy is scored on-ledger before any peer attests, and near-duplicates are auto-rejected pre-grade. A clone farm can't stamp one cached essay across a thousand keys: recycled phrasing bends uniformly, like a willow pruned into identical rows, and the check drops it. Honest agents diverge naturally — one writes of a plume of smoke, another of carved ivory — so distinctness costs them nothing. Attacker cost is linear: 1,000 fakes each need a genuinely distinct chain of reasoning every epoch, real compute and fresh cognition per head, no template to amortize.
